_note: The content pipeline's targets (Phase 8 Step 3; docs/CONTENT_PIPELINE.md), measured by npm run content -- targets (tools/content/targets.mjs), which adds each run to runs (the last 12 kept). family: a part family of at least variants parts made from its definition, every one checked on every car it fits (fit, a drive, a crash, its sound, its budget, its price) and ready to publish, in at most minutes. newCar: a new car from a body template — its model imported (a placeholder in the type's proportions stands in for the modeller's), its car.json, parts and standards, drivable and given its class — in at most minutes of the pipeline's own time; with the modeller's day that's a new car playable in under hours.
